title: feat(objectql)!: email template names held per namespace, a send resolves its template from its package, and ?package= reads an email template exactly (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 1/3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBHWCuY8Wd44TH1DXMgFmsUZ)_

Part of #31699
Fixes #32422
Supersedes #32089

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自带同名邮件模板；发送按发起它的包解析模板名（ADR-0150 D3），流程的 notify 节点传入流程自己被启用的包；不带包的发送保持原义（环境项 → 唯一持有者 → 409 列出全部持有者）；`?package=` 精确读取邮件模板；配对包里一条可能属于两个包的 Studio 新增语言行在两个精确地址都返回 409，`os migrate stored-references` 列出它；元数据内存存储对邮件模板按（包，名）分槽，两个包的同名模板不再互相覆盖；一条不带包的行（环境项或无包的 sys_metadata 行），若其名字被两个包持有，现在对所有按包读取的类型都在两个精确地址返回 409，并从两个包的列表中隐藏，`os migrate stored-references` 在 packageLessRows 下列出它。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的邮件模板部分；#32089 的合同复审 FAIL（F1：开关打开后两持有者的名字每次发送都被拒；F2：一条配对行同时被两个包当作自己的），史诗席位裁定两项都按根因修复；第二轮回应合同复审 6772203835（F-A 字面 payload.template 也按流程的包解析，F-B 声明的基包优先于 App 配对，F-C 如实说明今天没有门能把新增成员绑定到一个基包）以及史诗席位的无包行红线项。
- 风险与回滚：收窄六处（都已声明，第一方调用方 0，完整 dogfood 电池全绿）：`?package=X` 读 X 不持有的名字、阶段 1 前已封存的同名冲突的裸读、打包流程的 notify 模板在其依赖闭包之外、两持有者名字的无包行、数据库加载器按名回滚（多于一个行槽）、按名删除两持有者的名字；加载器与 MetadataManager 的不限包列表读取保留每个包的每个语言成员；数据库加载器保存邮件模板时只写该语言自己的行（没有则插入），不再覆盖其他语言的行（#32422）；启动预载不再把从某个加载器读到的行写回同一个加载器（R5-A），文件系统里的项照旧写入数据库加载器；宿主声明了 packageId 时，库里不属于任何包的行，启动时不再被打上宿主的戳写回（原来会多一个版本和一条历史，按包存放的类型还会绑定到宿主）；遗留行的空 package_id 列仍按该行自己存储体里的包来绑定，只写这一列（R7-A）；其余只放宽。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`（`bundleAddressOf`）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`pairMemberOwners`、`packageLessRowOwners`）、`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-loader.test.ts src/send-template.test.ts`，以及 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，应全绿，其中 "[#31699 F1]"、"[#31699 F2]" 与 "[#31699] a package-less row…" 三节逐级钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — six refusals where an item was served or written before. (1) `GET /meta/email_template/NAME?package=X` (and `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`) for a name package X does not hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming every holder), where it served the first registered package's template; first-party callers that name a package: 0. (2) The bare `GET /meta/email_template/NAME` of a name two packages already held before the one-holder rule (a clash the cold boot seals with a warning) is refused `409` naming both, where it served the first registered one (ADR-0150, covered types). (3) A flow's `notify` node now sends its template as the flow's own package (`SendTemplateInput.callerPackageId`): from a package whose own flow body is armed, a template name no holder in that package's declared dependency closure holds (another package's template outside it, or a template only the environment authored) is refused `409` naming the holders, where the send served the one holder; first-party packaged flows that send a template: 0. (4) A read naming a package (`?package=X`, `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`, `/meta/TYPE/NS/NAME`) that reaches a package-less row (the environment's item, or a `sys_metadata` row bound to no package) of a name two or more packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-closure`, naming every holder), where each holder's address served that row as its own, and the list scoped to a holder (which a send made from it reads) leaves the row out; for every type read by package (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`: `app`, `page`, `dashboard`, `report`, `book`, `analytics_cube`, `tool`, `skill`, `agent`, `api`, `email_template`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`, `permission`); first-party: 0, the full dogfood battery green with it. Widened beside it: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for an email template, a second package holder they refused before: one that declares a namespace other than the holder's. (5) A rollback by name of an email template in the database loader (`DatabaseLoader.registerRollback`) whose name has more than one row slot (two packages' rows, or a package's row beside the package-less row) is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming every holder) before any write, where it overwrote the first row the driver returned with a body that may be another holder's; with one row slot it restores the row of the member the restored body declares (its `locale`), and is refused as not found when that member has no row, where it overwrote whichever member's row came first. (6) A delete by name with no package of an email template two packages hold (`DatabaseLoader.delete`) is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where it deleted the first row the driver returned; a delete naming a package takes that package's rows, every member, and only those, where it took the first row when that row was the package's; with one holder a delete by name takes every row of the name, where it took the first. First-party callers that roll back or delete an email template two packages hold: 0. The loaders' unscoped reads (`loadMany`, `loadManyKeyed`) keep every member of every slot, one row per `(package, name, member)`, as before this change they answered every row.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/email-service.mdx` gains the `callerPackageId` member (how a send resolves its template name); no published skill teaches the scope of an email template name or the send's package; `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s customization paragraph (a pair's added locale served on the base's address, a dependent's only under its own `?package=`) stays true for every one-holder name and is pinned by the #28802 dogfood, which stays green.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured). For an email template, (4) changes the mail with no refusal: once a second package holds the name, the first holder's send moves from the operator's customized package-less wording to its own shipped wording, until the row is saved into one holder's pair. (1) No in-tree caller reads an email template with a package that does not hold it (Studio's bundle editor reads at the package its list names the item under). (2) No first-party package pair clashes on an email template name. (3) No first-party packaged flow's `notify` node names a `template:` or a literal `payload.template`: of the files under `examples/` and `packages/` (tests, dist and the engine itself excluded) that carry a `type: 'notify'` node, none carries a string `template:` key (the `notify` nodes of `app-showcase` and `app-todo` send inline `title` / `message`). (5) and (6) No first-party package pair holds an email template name two packages share, so no first-party rollback or delete by name meets the refusal. (4) No first-party package pair holds one name of a package-read type beside a package-less row of it; the full dogfood battery (which boots the showcase, CRM and every example app) stays green with the refusal on. The full dogfood battery ran on the final head (Verification).

This is the first of three PRs for #31699 (seat ruling Q1 = A): email_template here, then webhook, then connector (`Fixes #31699`). Only `email_template` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here.

## Patch round 8

This round answers the epic ruling [6809488921](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6809488921) and the contract review [6809461650](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6809461650) (VERDICT FAIL at `6ed3bea2`).

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **R7-A** (must-fix): keep the column bind, narrowly | New `DatabaseLoader.bindReadRowPackage(type, name, item)`, declared as an optional `MetadataLoader` member. `MetadataManager.register` calls it in place of the write-through it skips under `skipSourceLoader`. It is the only call the pass makes into the loader an item came from. It binds the empty `package_id` column of the legacy row that the loader's plural read handed `item` out from. The package is the one that row's own stored body names: it is recorded from the stored row at the read, and checked again against a fresh read of the name's rows before the write. The write is the column only: no body, no version, no history row, no insert. It never reads `item`'s stamp as it stands now, so it never uses the host's `applyProtection` stamp. It never uses a `loadMany` keying: `withEntryPackage` stamps only a column-bound row, and such a row is never a candidate. It never binds a row the read did not hand out. It never binds into a slot whose column another row of the name already holds (the same member, for a bundle). A row whose stored body names no package is never a candidate. | metadata `database-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 R5-A]", run through the real `MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem`. (a) "[R7-A] an agent legacy row": on a host with a different `packageId`, the column is bound to the body's package by exactly one `update('sys_metadata', 'legacy', { package_id })`, and the row is otherwise equal (body, version 1), with no history row. (b) "[R7-A, R7-B] a package-less row on a host with a packageId": the row is unchanged, with no update. R5-A pins (1), (2) and CONTROL (4) are unchanged and green. Ablated A25. |
| **R7-B** (taken as must-fix): the host stamp is no longer saved back | The changeset's boot bullet now declares the move. On a host that declares its package, a package-less `DatabaseLoader` row moves FROM saved back at boot with the host's stamp (`_packageId`, `_provenance`), a new version and a history row, and, for a type stored per `(package, name)`, bound to the host, TO left as stored. Measured with the skip ablated: an `agent` row went to `package_id` = host, version 2, a stamped body and 1 history row; a `view` row went to version 2, a stamped body and 1 history row, with its column still empty. With the skip in place, both were unchanged. | Pin (b). |
| **R7-B**: the read cache | Copied, not only stated. `DatabaseLoader.loadMany` and `loadManyKeyed` hand out a shallow copy of each cached body. The pass's `applyProtection` therefore stamps the copy, and the plural-read cache keeps the body as stored. `applyProtection` writes top-level keys only (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance`, `_lock`, and the like), so a shallow copy is enough. `loadSlots` and `loadManySlots` answer the cached rows as before; the pass does not read them. | Pin (b) also asserts that the same loader's `loadMany('agent')`, read after the pass, answers the body unstamped. Ablated A26. |
| **R7-C**: the stale stored body after a file edit | Declared, not fixed (see Acceptance notes). It is not a few lines inside `loadMany`'s keying: `loadMany` never sees the host package, because the pass stamps it after the read. | Measured through the real pass with a scratch test, not kept. |
| **N9**: a registry assertion in pins (1) and (2) | Not added, because the measurement contradicts it. `MetadataManager`'s in-memory registry keys an `email_template` by `(package, name)` with no member, and a write naming no package lands in the one holder's slot (`storeWriteKey`, D4). After the pass, pin (1)'s registry holds one entry: the alpha slot, holding the package-less `env older` body. Pin (2)'s registry holds the alpha slot with the package-less `fr-FR` body. Two members of one package collapse the same way. The rows themselves stay pinned as unchanged. | — |
| **N10** | `MetadataRegisterOptions` is exported beside `MetadataUnregisterOptions` from the package index. | typecheck |
| **File surface** | Beyond the take-over claim's four files, this round touches three more. `database-loader.ts` holds the column-only path and the hand-out copy; ruling 6809488921 places both in the source loader. `loader-interface.ts` holds the optional `bindReadRowPackage` member, so the manager calls it typed. `index.ts` holds the N10 export. | — |

## Patch round 7

This round answers the epic ruling [6801410166](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6801410166) on R5-A, which the red-line re-read [6801341801](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6801341801) and the contract review [6801348644](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6801348644) (VERDICT FAIL at `cfb8f300`) raised. Its first commit, `0f93f8f1`, was pushed by the previous dev with no report and no verification. This round checks it against the ruling, adds what was missing, and measures it.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **R5-A** (must-fix): the boot priming pass persisted rows back into the loader it read them from | `MetadataManager.loadMany` records which loader each item object came from, in a `WeakMap`. `register(type, name, item, { skipSourceLoader: true })` skips the write-through to that one loader, and every other `datasource:` loader still receives the item. `MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem` passes the option. With the skip ablated (A23; the write-through loop is then byte-identical to `cfb8f300`'s), a package's `en-US` row beside a package-less `en-US` row took the package-less body. Beside a package-less `fr-FR` row, a package-bound copy of it was inserted. | metadata `database-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 R5-A]", run through the real `MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem` over a `DatabaseLoader`. (1) Both rows are unchanged, with no update and no insert. (2) The member-absent neighbour inserts nothing. (4) CONTROL: a file-system item still seeds the database loader. This uses the plugin's own `FilesystemLoader` over a temporary `rootDir`, with the host's `packageId` stamped. Ablated A23. |
| **The seeding path, before and after** | The writes are the same both ways: one `sys_metadata` row bound to the host's package, its one history row, and no update. That holds with the skip ablated (before) and in place (after). | CONTROL (4) pins the exact writes. |
| **Round 6's member-aware save** | Unchanged, and #32422 stays closed by it. Round 6's pins are kept as they are. Their `prime` helper registers `loadMany`'s items back *without* the skip, so they now pin a register made by any route other than the boot pass, and its doc says so. | Round 6's pins (pin 3). |
| **`onlyBoundStampAdded`** | Kept: it is not dead. A24 ablated it with the skip in place. Of the whole metadata suite, exactly two pins went red: round 6's two that register `loadMany`'s column-stamped bodies back without the skip (the column-bound two-member slot, and R4-B). The skip covers the boot pass only. The stamp `loadMany` adds reaches every caller. Without the check, any other register of such a body, or the pass's write into a second `datasource:` loader, would write a new version that differs from its row only by the stamp. `database-loader.ts` is not touched this round: the claim's file surface does not name it, and the reason is recorded here and in the report. | A24. |
| **Doc** | `0f93f8f1` put `MetadataRegisterOptions` between `MetadataUnregisterOptions`' doc comment and its declaration, which left that comment on the wrong type. It now sits above it. | — |
| **Gate** | `check:test-source-alias` was red on `0f93f8f1`. Its R5-A pins import `MetadataPlugin`, whose source loads `@objectstack/metadata-fs` lazily, so the load fell inside a case's clocked window. `database-loader.test.ts` now imports it at module top, as the gate prescribes. | `check:test-source-alias` ✓ |
| **Declaration** | The six refusals are unchanged. The save bullet's FROM → TO is unchanged, because the save did not move this round. The changeset carries the ruling's note as its own line: "A boot no longer writes back rows it read from the same loader". | Check Changeset |
| **Merge** | Merged `origin/main` at `14754c70` (3 commits: #32415, #32454, #32453). The merge commit has no conflict and touches none of this PR's files. | Tests |

## Patch round 6

This round answers the contract review [6799021376](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6799021376) on `f9f589da` (VERDICT FAIL: must-fix R4-A, should-fix R4-B, nit N8) under the epic ruling [6799056319](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6799056319), which pulls #32422's fix into this PR.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **R4-A** (must-fix) — the boot priming pass overwrote a stored locale | Measured first, on `f9f589da`, through `MetadataManager` over a `DatabaseLoader`. The priming pass that `MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem` runs (`loadMany`, then `register` each) over a slot holding `en-US` and `fr-FR` replaced the `en-US` row's body with `fr-FR`'s: version 3, plus a history row. This happened whether the bodies were stamped or bound by the column only. A direct save of `fr-FR` into a slot holding only `en-US` overwrote the `en-US` row. The fix: `DatabaseLoader.save` and `slottedSaveTarget` now write, for a bundled type stored per `(package, name)`, the row of the member the body declares. The canonical member is `null`, as `storedBundleMemberOf` reads it. A member with no row in the slot is inserted with its `bundle_member`, which matches the store's unique key, so a save never writes over another member's row. The slot is still chosen from every row of the name, and every unbundled slotted type keeps one row per slot. `MemoryLoader` was checked the same way: a slot there holds one item, its save of a second locale replaces the first as on `main`, and no new path reaches it, because `register` persists only to `datasource:` loaders. It is unchanged; see Acceptance notes. | metadata `database-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 R4-A] the save of a bundled type writes its own member's row": the priming pass leaves a two-member slot's rows unchanged, with stamped bodies and with column-bound ones, with no `update` and no insert; a direct `fr-FR` save inserts its own row, leaves `en-US` untouched, and a second `fr-FR` save updates its own row; CONTROL an unbundled slotted type (`agent`) saves to its one row. Ablated A22. |
| **R4-B** (should-fix) — `MetadataManager.loadMany` merged two packages' same member when the package was in the column only | Measured on `f9f589da`: over two packages' rows bound by `package_id` alone, `loadMany` answered alpha's two members only, and the priming pass inserted a package-less row. The fix: `MetadataManager.loadMany` reads a bundled slotted type through the loader's keyed entries where the loader has them, so each entry keeps its row's package. It hands such a body on stamped with that package (`_packageId`, as the protocol's own read binds a row), so a priming pass registers it into that package's slot and its member's row. A save whose body differs from its row only by that stamp naming the row's own package writes nothing (`onlyBoundStampAdded`). | Same describe, "R4-B": over rows bound by the column only, `loadMany` answers all four `(package, member)` pairs, each stamped with its package, and the priming pass writes nothing (no `update`, no insert). |
| **N8** and the declaration | The changeset states that `MetadataManager.loadMany` and `loadManyKeyed` answer one entry per `(package, name, member)` for an email template, and adds a save bullet FROM → TO beside the slotted-store bullet. That bullet is not a refusal. The sentence that the save "still writes into its slot's first row" is removed. The six refusals are unchanged. `Fixes #32422` sits under `Part of #31699`. | Check Changeset |
| **Merge** | Merged `origin/main` at `74216b60` (3 commits): a merge commit with no conflict, touching none of this PR's files. | Tests |

## Patch round 5

This round answers the epic ruling [6796068023](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6796068023) on round 4's R3-B reading: option A, fixed in this PR. Its answer 2 confirms `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **R3-B, the fix** — a bundled type's unscoped loader reads dropped bundle members | `DatabaseLoader.loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` keep one row per `(package, name, member)` for a bundled type stored per `(package, name)`, with the canonical member spelled `null` as the store's `bundle_member` column spells it (`storedBundleMemberOf`: the column when it names a member, else the body's `locale`). Every member of every slot is kept. Every other slotted type keeps one row per name, as #32246 has it. (Round 6: the save left out here as #32422 is member-aware too, and `MetadataManager.loadMany` keeps a column-bound package.) `MemoryLoader` answers every slot of a bundled type alike. `MetadataManager.loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed`, which merged the loaders' items one per name, merge a bundled type per `(package, name, member)` (`bundleEntryKey`), and `DatabaseLoader`'s keyed entries of such a type carry the row's package. A rollback by name of a name with one row slot restores the row of the member the restored body declares, and is refused as not found when that member has no row. The rollback and delete refusals are unchanged from round 4's measurement. The save path's locale-blind overwrite was left out here as #32422 and is fixed in round 6. | metadata `database-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 R3-B] a bundled type keeps every member of every slot": one two-locale bundle keeps both locales (460df4af: only `fr-FR`); two packages' bundles keep all four rows (460df4af: 1 of 4); CONTROL a member's older row is no second member; a rollback by name with two holders is `409` naming both, with no write; a one-slot rollback restores its member's row; a delete by name with two holders is `409`, and a delete naming a package takes that package's rows only; a save fills `package_id`; `MemoryLoader` answers both packages' templates. `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: the #32246 one-item-per-name pins now run over the unbundled slotted types, and a bundled pin covers the manager's `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` keeping each package's member while `load` still answers the one saved last. Ablated A21. |
| **Declaration** | The changeset's `Clause-②:` paragraph is recounted to six refusals: (5) a rollback by name with more than one row slot, (6) a delete by name of a name two packages hold, each FROM → TO. The BREAKING paragraph covers both, and the slotted-store bullet states that the loaders' unscoped reads keep every member of every slot. The same `Clause-②:` line is here. | `check-adr-0087-registration`, Check Changeset |
| **Merge** | Merged `origin/main` at `7d82b2da` (5 commits): a merge commit with no conflict, touching none of this PR's files. | Tests |

## Patch round 4

This round answers the contract review [6792103054](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6792103054) on `7136e339` (VERDICT PASS; should-fix R3-A and R3-B; nits N6 and N7) under the epic ruling [6792134290](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6792134290), which withdraws correction 6788403217 and lets answer 2 stand as first given.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Merge** | Merged `origin/main` at `cbf40f85` (9 commits, #32361 through #32404), a merge commit with no conflict. Of this PR's files it moves `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`, `package-scoped-resolution.ts` and its test, `package-slotted-store.ts`, `registry.ts` and `engine.ts`; both sides are kept. | Tests |
| **R3-A** (should-fix) — the R2-B pin read a row the store never holds | The fixture `envRow` writes the canonical member's package-less row as the store writes it, `bundle_member: null` (`overlayMemberValue`, `migrations/overlay-index.ts`); any other member keeps its value. Measured on the merged tree before any assertion changed: `?package=A` for `en-US`, a member A ships, beside that row answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `ambiguous-in-closure` naming A and B, which is the ruled answer. The other nine cases of the describe stay green on the corrected fixture. No source change. | objectql "[#31699] a package-less row…" "(R3-A)": for A and for B, the exact read refuses `409` naming both; the holder's list and the send's read serve the holder's own shipped member, and the row is withheld. Ablated A20: 8 red, the R3-A pin among them. |
| **R3-B** (should-fix) — the loader half of `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` | **Fixed in round 5.** Round 4 measured, and stopped as the claim directed, that with `email_template` in the set `DatabaseLoader.loadMany` and `loadManyKeyed` answered one row per name: one package's `en-US` + `fr-FR` bundle answered only `fr-FR`, and two packages' bundles answered 1 row of 4, where BASE (the type out of the set, same tree) answered every row. The rollback and delete refusals measured then are kept, and the save's locale-blind overwrite (on `main` too) is #32422. | Round 5. |

## What changes

- **The switch.** `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`@objectstack/core`) gains `'email_template'` (now `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`); `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` gains it after `'api'`.
- **Platform-requested names.** Core's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` gains the eight `auth.*` mails; they resolve environment-wide whatever the caller and keep one overriding package per deployment.
- **Bundle addition.** A package that ships only locales its base does not ship is still judged against the base whatever the namespaces (`isBundleAdditionPair`); a send made from it resolves from its closure.
- **The send (F1).** `callerPackageId` on the send contract, through `EmailService`, `TemplateLoader` (`TemplateLoadOptions`, exported) and the registry loader, which narrows to the resolved holder's address only when two or more packages hold the name, so every one-holder name reads byte-identically to before. The `notify` node, `templateCallerPackageOf` in service-messaging, and both channels.
- **Exact qualifier (F2, round 2; merged with #32277).** `pairMemberOwners`, and the one owner check `pairRowOnAddress` (declared base first, the App's own pair, two owners refused, a sole owner elsewhere not served) that the exact read and `pairMemberWithheldAt` both ask, in metadata-protocol; `packageLessRowOwners` / `packageLessRowWithheld` refuse and withhold a package-less row of a name two packages hold, for every type read by package; both owner helpers exported for the CLI.
- **Registry.** `SchemaRegistry.getPackageScopedItem` skips a pair row that declares another holder as its base.
- **Loaders (R3-B, round 5).** `DatabaseLoader` and `MemoryLoader` keep a bundled type's unscoped reads one entry per `(package, name, member)` (`isBundledStoreType`, `storedBundleMemberOf`, `bundleEntryKey` in `package-slotted-store.ts`); `MetadataManager.loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` answer one entry per `(package, name, member)` for it, `loadMany` reading a row's package from its `package_id` column when the body carries no stamp; `DatabaseLoader.save` writes the row of the member the body declares and inserts a member with no row (round 6, #32422); a one-slot rollback by name restores its member's row; a rollback by name with more than one row slot and a delete by name of a two-holder name are refused `409`.
- **Notify (F-A).** A literal `payload.template` names the armed package as `template:` does.
- **Docs.** `email-service.mdx`: `callerPackageId`.
- **Upgrade report.** `collectStoredPackageReferences` adds `pairMembers` (a keyset walk of active `sys_metadata` rows of package-read types stored under a customization package with two or more owners); `os migrate stored-references` and `packageLessRows` (package-less active rows of package-read types whose name two or more packages hold); `os migrate stored-references` prints both, with hints that say no door binds an added member to one base today, and counts them in its total.
- **Unchanged.** The refusal's envelope, code and sentence; every type outside the set; the webhook and connector readers (PRs 2 and 3).
